51550.residential_note: a home is a building of at most 500 m2 on a parcel whose 2020 property class is 20xx (residential; 2010 is the single-family class on two thirds of all parcels); the class table itself was not found, so this is read from the counts

51830.name: Williamsburg
51830.residential_note: no use codes in the regional parcels: a home is a building of at most 500 m2 on a parcel zoned single-family (RS), multifamily (RM), downtown residential (RDT) or a planned residential district (PUD, PDR)

51093.name: Isle of Wight County
51093.residential_note: no use codes in the regional parcels: a home is a building of at most 500 m2 on a parcel zoned rural agricultural conservation, neighborhood conservation, suburban, rural or urban residential, or planned residential (RAC, NC, SR, RR, UR, PD-R), or a Smithfield or Windsor residential, agricultural or mobile home district; farm buildings on RAC land under 500 m2 are counted as homes too

51199.name: York County

51095.name: James City County
51095.residential_note: no use codes in the regional parcels: a home is a building of at most 500 m2 on a parcel zoned R1 to R8, A1 (general agriculture) or PUD-R; mixed use (MU) parcels are left out

51073.name: Gloucester County
51073.residential_note: no use codes in the regional parcels: a home is a building of at most 500 m2 on a parcel zoned single family (SF-1), suburban or rural countryside (SC-1, RC-1, RC-2), bayside conservation (C-2), multifamily (MF-1) or a planned unit development (PUD1)
